title: VTG Longwear Quartz Dual Dial Women’s Watch White Leather Strap Japan Movt AS IS
descriptionText:
VTG Longwear quartz women’s dual dial watch with rectangular gold tone case and white leather strap.
Watch shows significant cosmetic wear including heavy aging to the strap, discoloration, and plating wear around the case edges. Strap may need replacement depending on buyer preference. Battery not tested and working condition is unknown, therefore sold AS IS for parts, repair, or restoration.
Please review all photos carefully for exact condition and wear.
